## <br>Design Curves — `r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "$k_h$"` {.scrollable}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_fig/kh.qmd",
  stem = .composeTargetStem("kh-curves"),
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(
    MODELS = c(rigid = "Rigid Models", flexible = "Flexible Models", ensemble = "Ensemble Models"),
    CAP = readCaption("fig.kh"),
    CAP.MCE = readCaption("fig.kh.MCE"),
    p.target = "mean"
  ),
  root = root
)
```
